notes: «حدثني مولى، أسماء» names the mawla only by relation to Asma, so he is a relation link; the compiler's later commentary («ومولى أسماء بنت أبي بكر الصديق اسمه عبد الله») gives a name outside the chain, which is not used here; «قال سمعت عمر» makes Umar the last link (rule 5); «عمر» is occurrence 2 (occurrence 1 is inside «ابن عمر»); «وفي الباب عن علي وحذيفة وأنس» and the later comments are the compiler's notes, not chain
